raw_response:
I am 64 years old and have worked these 6 mu in Quzhou for 40 years. I know every inch of this land. My household is just me, so I cannot afford to take big risks or try fancy new methods — I stick to what works and what I can manage alone. This year, as every year, I will plant winter wheat on all 6 mu after rotary tillage in October. I use improved wheat seed from the local seed station because it is reliable, and I apply compound fertilizer as a base dressing plus urea at green-up and jointing. I will irrigate three times from my well: wintering water, green-up water, and jointing water. For pests and weeds, I spray herbicide once and insecticide once or twice when aphids appear. I expect about 550 kg per mu of wheat if the weather cooperates. After wheat harvest in early June, I will immediately plant summer maize using Dengbai 605 hybrid seed with no-tillage direct seeding — there is no time to plow between harvest and sowing, and everyone here does it this way. I will side-dress fertilizer at the big trumpet stage and irrigate twice. For maize, I spray herbicide once and insecticide once for corn borer. I expect about 600 kg per mu of maize. This plan has fed me for decades and I see no reason to change it.
